title: Strip Mall
content: Does anyone else have an outdoor/strip mall? The dream I had last night I was trying to find something in a Walmart/zellers/target mash up. I couldn’t find the thing and ended up in a large parking lot with a fast-food place and a bunch of random stores like the indoor mall. This is just an example of the dreams in this area but the area itself has been there for a while. The bus seems to be the only way to and from.
